system.flavor:
Move a friend across a room before a thrown bottle lands, put a companion on the far side of a doorway as it slams, step a child out of a horse's path, or pull someone off a collapsing stair onto solid floor. Two paces, through the Court's door, before the blow falls.

Not enough to pass through a wall, cross a street, or move anyone who does not want to go.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Move it up to 2 units along a clear path; it gains +1 Fortitude against that attack. Recheck target validity afterward.

surges.html: Ignore difficult terrain during the movement.
Swap it with another willing creature adjacent to its starting space instead; the new legal target receives the Fortitude bonus.
